source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 1131 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1131.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 1131 was established by Ordinance No. 33135, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 11, 2025. (Ord. 33135)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1131.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 1131 is established on property located south of Great Trinity Forest Way and east of Jim Miller Road. The size of PD 1131 is approximately 16.5 acres. (Ord. 33135)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1131.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are references to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 33135)

sections.title: Exhibit
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1131.104. EXHIBIT.

The following exhibit is incorporated into this article: Exhibit 1131A: development plan. (Ord. 33135)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1131.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) For a project receiving a mixed income housing bonus in accordance with Section 51P-1131.115, development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 1131A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) For all other uses, no development plan is required, and the provisions of Section 51A-4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a development plan, site analysis plan, conceptual plan, development schedule, and landscape plan do not apply. (Ord. 33135)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1131.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The only main uses permitted are those main uses permitted in the MF-3(A) Multifamily District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the MF-3(A) Multifamily District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the MF-3(A) Multifamily District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the MF-3(A) Multifamily District is subject to DIR in this district; etc. (Ord. 33135)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1131.107. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any area in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted:

-- Amateur communication tower. -- Open storage. -- Private stable. (Ord. 33135)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1131.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the MF-3(A) Multifamily District apply.

(b) Development bonuses. This subsection applies to a project that complies with 51P- 1131.115.

(1) Urban form setback. Urban form setback is not required.

(2) Residential proximity slope. The residential proximity slope defined in Section 51A-4.412 does not apply. (Ord. 33135)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1131.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use.

(b) For a project that qualifies for a mixed-income housing bonus in accordance with Section 51P-1131.115, off-street parking for a multifamily use must be provided in accordance with Section 51A-4.1107(c)(2). (Ord. 33135)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1131.112. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 33135)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1131.113. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 33135)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1131.114. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 33135)

sections.title: Mixed-Income Housing Development Bonus
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1131.115. MIXED-INCOME HOUSING DEVELOPMENT BONUS.

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, compliance with Division 51A- 4.1100, as amended, is required to obtain the development bonuses in Sections 51P-1131.108 and 51P-1131.109.

(b) Reserved units. A minimum of five percent of the residential units must be made available at an affordable rate with an income band of 61 percent to 80 percent of adjusted median family income.

(c) Development regulations.

(1) In general. Except as provided in this section, compliance with Section 51A- 4.1107 is required. If there is a conflict between Section 51A-4.1107 and this article, the text of this article control.

(2) Surface parking. Surface parking may be provided within the front yard setback.

(3) Sidewalks and walking trails.

(A) A minimum six-foot-wide unobstructed sidewalk with a minimum five-foot-wide parkway must be provided along all street frontages.

(B) Where sidewalks abut a driving surface, an off-street or on-street pedestrian loading zone, or a parking surface, a minimum of one of the following buffers must be provided:

(i) landscaping plantings with a minimum height of 36 inches; or

(ii) bollards with a minimum height of 36 inches, spaced no more than six feet from each other.

(C) Sidewalks must be continuous and level across all driveways, loading areas, and curb cuts and designed to be at the same grade as the existing sidewalk subject to approval of the director.

(D) A pedestrian walking trail must be provided and may be built within the tree preservation area. The trail must have a minimum linear distance of 1,250 feet.

(d) Driveways.

(1) Maximum number of driveways per street frontage is one.

(2) Maximum driveway approach width where it crosses a sidewalk is 26 feet.

(3) At the intersection of each driveway with a sidewalk or pedestrian path, driveways must be clearly marked by colored concrete, patterned or stamped concrete, or brick pavers for pedestrian crossing.

(e) Pedestrian amenities. A grouping of a minimum of two of each of the following pedestrian amenities must be provided on each street frontage at a spacing of no greater than one per 300 feet:

(1) Bench.

(2) Trash and recycling receptacle.

(3) Bicycle rack. (Ord. 33135)

sections.title: Tree Preservation Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1131.116. TREE PRESERVATION AREA.

(a) Buildings and parking areas may not be developed within the tree preservation area shown on the development plan.

(b) The tree preservation area may not be changed using the minor amendment process. (Ord. 33135)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1131.120. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 33135)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1131.117. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city.

The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this division, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 33135)
